mostWorthwhile.text: Having Ren test the installed stop with the network disconnected was most worthwhile: it showed that a bench-tested component and a working independent safety path are different things.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the test rig on the installed cabinet was least worthwhile; it had no available operation, and the next step remained unclear.

surprise.text: The stop button first needed a service lead rather than the contact test I expected. The compatibility feedback handled that preparation automatically.

arbitrary.text: The operator's key initially had no available operation, and it was not obvious when it would become usable. Inspecting the cabinet clarified the first preparation, but not the whole sequence.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: the pump repair made the distinction between local control, independent safety and monitoring concrete, and the working water service gave it a tangible payoff.
